response.text:
No, processor power does not stay constant. 

The pattern is as follows:
- When the CPU is idle, it uses low power.
- When running normal programs, it uses moderate power.
- When performing heavy calculations, it uses high power.
- During short bursts of activity, it may demand very high peak power.
